# dnssd-mdns

DNS-SD — mDNS browse and answers for the NMOS service types, on the lab link.

- Captured on 2026-10-04 with the released dhs v0.36.2: `dhs consumer nmos discover`.
- `capture.pcapng` — the conversation as it was on the wire.
- `tshark.tree` — that capture through `../../../wireshark/dhs_nmos.lua` (`tshark -O dhs_nmos,dhs_nmos_http`).
